title: object list pages title themselves with the singular label ("Project") while the nav entry and the page content are the plural list ("Projects")
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect — `reach:` every object list page, measured; separate card under the maintainer's quota exception (provenance below).
Reader: objectui triage first-touch → `domain:ui` lane (`packages/app-shell`); one PR.
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed, objectui): "object list page title uses singular label instead of plural label, breadcrumb singular" → 3 hits, all closed, none about the list title (objectui#10636 is the record-count footer).

Environment: framework `ce577ec4` showcase booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on its own port and SQLite file; console = objectui `f9f4a62d` (`apps/console` Vite dev server, and a production `vite build` for timings); Chromium 141 headless, 1440×900, seeded admin.

## Repro

Open any object list: Showcase → Projects / Tasks / Accounts / Invoices …, Setup → Users / Positions / Permission Sets …

Actual: sidebar entry "Projects", page title "Project", breadcrumb "Project ▾"; likewise "Tasks" → "Task", "Settings" → "Setting", "Users" → "User", "Business Units" → "Business Unit". The served object metadata carries a `pluralLabel` (checked on `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_user`).

## Where

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the `PageHeader` title renders `objectLabel(objectDef)` (the singular label) on the list page; the breadcrumb follows the same label.

## Expected

A list page is titled with the object's plural label (falling back to the singular one only when no `pluralLabel` is declared); the record page keeps the singular.

Provenance: filed as a separate card on the maintainer's explicit instruction in the dispatching session, which lifts the per-fire filing quota for this batch of seven, verbatim — 「重新思考以上和用户体验相关的问题，哪些需要立卡」 then 「分开立 7 张」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; companion checklist card objectstack-ai/objectui#11672. Filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
